hero.verification: Downloaded the original (3648x2736) from Wikimedia Commons and viewed it directly: the file's own description reads 'WonderWorks, 9067 International Drive, Orlando, Florida', and the image shows the building's unmistakable upside-down facade and roofline — a one-of-a-kind structure that cannot be confused with any other place. Not geotagged, but the address in the description is the same WonderWorks the pick names.
